notes: Sheet is drawn rotated relative to sheet 19 (Baymiller is near-vertical here). Stone Street (50') is one straight diagonal (both building lines fitted, dx/dy -0.287) from W 6th (T, block 40 north of it) to W 3rd (T). Carlisle Av jogs at Stone: centreline y~1407 on the west side and y~1317 on the east side (east part drawn on sheet 21, 50-60'), so two T's named (west of Stone) / (east of Stone). Sweeney Alley is printed SWEENEY (AVERY ALLEY) and AVERY ALLEY at Baymiller; its east-of-Stone continuation angles ESE but meets Stone within ~10 px of the west part, so recorded as one cross. Webb Alley (printed WEBB ALLEY, 20') runs from Baymiller (T) past King Alley (T) and across Stone. King Alley (10') runs W 4th to Webb Alley parallel to Stone. W 4th slopes ESE (~0.177) and ends at Baymiller. Baymiller is irregular between W 5th and Sweeney Alley: the Great Western Hotel block's diagonal west face leaves a wide open area east of the street; the W 5th crossing is taken on the north alignment's centreline (the four-corner centre would be ~80 px further east). W 3rd: north side is the L&N R.R. freight house property; centre taken midway between its line and the south block line (50'). Jane (printed JANE only, 30' by measurement) enters from the north and ends at W 6th. Baymiller/W 6th sits ~45 px below the top paper edge; W 6th continues west onto sheet 19, Baymiller does not continue north (sheet 19).
